title: Write a word-frequency command
prompt: Write the command bin/wordfreq in the current directory, as README.md specifies (it does not exist yet). It must be an executable file that runs by itself (`bin/wordfreq -n 3 samples/a.txt`, from any directory), written in sh, awk or python3 (standard library only). tests/run_tests.sh has two examples (`sh tests/run_tests.sh`); hidden tests check every rule in README.md. Do not modify README.md or tests/run_tests.sh.
